name: college-fantasy-football
description: College Fantasy Football app test harness.

scripts.test:frontend: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { readdirSync } = require('node:fs'); const { join } = require('node:path'); for (const file of readdirSync('frontend/tests').filter((name) => name.endsWith('.test.js')).sort()) { console.log('Running ' + file); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [join('frontend/tests', file)], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.status) process.exit(result.status); }"
scripts.check:frontend: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { readdirSync } = require('node:fs'); const { join } = require('node:path'); for (const file of readdirSync('frontend/tests').filter((name) => name.endsWith('.test.js')).sort()) { console.log('Checking ' + file); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--check', join('frontend/tests', file)], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.status) process.exit(result.status); }"
